lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. No decision is needed from Brandon now.

Chain 38 is read, merged and on origin main (5b76c959) since 20:55 UTC (1:55 PM MT). It is round one's twelve branches made and measured together on a helper machine. Every step ended clean and every condition of the order was met. Stated by the helper in its report: winter's two guards unmoved; M3 at review spring-rest 0.9022, summer-rest 0.8624, fall-rest 0.8587; M4 of shakes 1 to 4 0.9694, 0.889, 0.956, 0.9599; M5 0.9932, 1, 0.9882, 0.9996; 1,773,508 of 1,800,000 triangles at high; whole test run 1035 passed, 8 skipped. Measured here: the six moved stills' hashes equal the helper's, and the sound tests a helper skips pass, 46 of 46.

Falls against chain 37, each accepted in round one with a floor: summer's miniature part of M3 0.980 to 0.863, because the air's seeds and lights now stand in front of the miniature; fall's base part 0.916 to 0.859 with the wall; fall's miniature part 0.989 to 0.974 with the tree; M4 of shake 2 0.9434 to 0.889 with spring's base. Rises: spring's base part 0.900 to 0.934, summer's base part 0.854 to 0.862.

Looked at by me beside the approved pictures, at rest and at the landing, spring, summer and fall: nothing is broken or missing. Fall moved most (the tree's long boughs). Summer's base is still a darker grey brown than the approved pale cream, its air at rest is whiter and denser than the approved's green gold, and its swirl at the landing hides the miniature more than the approved's. Spring's base is a darker green than the approved's. All four seasons remain below the bar by my eye; his eye outranks mine.

The tenth publish is in the making on that commit: the page's first pictures are being drawn here now (about 20 minutes), then come the whole test run and the build, a fresh security review and a check of the live page. Until then the live page is the ninth publish, which still has the first shake's stall.

Round two: all twelve builders have the new list and work on their orders; none pushes before my word. The pictures for the five fresh critics are being drawn: twelve stills, and nine strips of the change of season on three helper machines, due between 21:00 and 22:00 UTC (2:00 and 3:00 PM MT) by the helpers' own reckoning. All 16 places for agents are in use, so the critics start as places open, summer first. The close is named after their lists, not before 22:15 UTC (3:15 PM MT). Then chain 39, a publish, Preview 07 and the status that asks whether to move on to the film and the 4K masters.

Open item 262 (the first shake's stall) is closed as mended on main; on a real graphics card unknown. New open item 266: the texture step rewrites three public files of parts nobody changed; the helper put them back, as the rule says; to be read before the freeze.
Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000, no call since 05:47 UTC on Thursday. No film render and no new preview since Preview 06.
